'''The Venture Co. Mine'''{{co|61|47|Mulgore}} (also spelled '''Venture Company Mine''') is an enormous [[mine]] run by the [[Venture Company]] in the eastern cliffs of [[Mulgore]]. The mine has three entrance points. The first is the main entrance where [[Supervisor Fizsprocket]] resides—it is the only entrance accessible on foot. Fizsprocket is the goblin in charge of Venture Co. operations in the tauren homeland. The second entrance is a cliff, and the third entrance is a small lumber camp.
